prompt:
Use case: product-mockup / logo-brand. Create one polished LANDSCAPE brand application presentation board for the Chinese company 礼林生态, showing FIVE practical uses of the SAME selected logo. The attached image is the authoritative identity specification and actual deliverable sheet: reproduce its open-square 礼 emblem and wordmark consistently across all mockups. Do not redesign it, add leaves, a heart, a seal border, extra strokes or invent another logo. Keep the Chinese brand exactly 礼林生态, the English exactly LILIN ECO, the full company name where appropriate exactly 达州礼林生态科技有限责任公司. Culture wording exactly 善心 · 善念 · 善行. This is a MONOCHROME application proposal: black, white and realistic neutral materials only, no green or other accent colors.
Composition: clean sophisticated brand design studio case-study sheet, very generous margins, five clearly labeled editorial panels of varied size. Main upper-left panel “网站” shows a close view of a desktop browser homepage header: horizontal black emblem + 礼林生态 lockup on an airy ivory/white corporate site, subtle giant background 善心, elegant Chinese typography, understated menu. Upper-right panel “App” shows a close-up phone screen with one black square app tile bearing the exact white emblem, with the readable app label 礼林生态, plus a flat 1024-style black icon nearby. Lower-left panel “公司公告” shows a white A4 company announcement letterhead on a desk, exact full company name at top with small emblem, title 公司公告, a few neutral gray placeholder rules rather than fabricated business news, clean footer with culture wording. Lower-middle panel “广告展板” shows a wide minimal wall-mounted board using the same black emblem and large 礼林生态 with culture wording, plus website www.lilinst.com discreetly. Lower-right panel “商品应用” shows a plain white presentation box, black kraft-style hangtag and neutral canvas bag branded with the same emblem; these are generic brand application samples, no product claims or certifications. A very small heading at top “礼林生态 / 品牌应用”. Professional restrained lighting and beautiful material realism; each logo remains flat printed artwork with exact consistent contours. Emblem must be fully visible with adequate clear space in each scene. The emphasis is how a unified usable identity adapts in scale and arrangement, not a collage of unrelated logo concepts. No lorem ipsum, no awards, no invented customer names, no colored graphics, no unnecessary paragraph copy.
productionAssets: SVG files are code-native shapes; PNG and ICO are exports of those SVGs. Mockup image is an illustrative application preview.
